es: Coordinar un viaje familiar que cambió de planes: explicar el plan anterior, fijar plazos con by, proyectar una duración y cerrar un acuerdo con preguntas corteses.

teaching.en: We were going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house instead.
teaching.es: Íbamos a alojarnos en un hotel, pero alquilaremos una casa.
teaching.explanationEs: Was going to + verbo: el plan anterior; will + verbo: la decisión actual.
segments: We were going to stay in a hotel,
but we will rent a house instead.
teaching.audioText: We were going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house instead.

teaching.en: We need to book the tickets by Friday.
teaching.es: Tenemos que reservar los billetes antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: By + momento: el plazo máximo para hacerlo.
teaching.audioText: We need to book the tickets by Friday.

teaching.en: The deadline for the deposit is the twentieth of June.
teaching.es: El plazo para pagar el anticipo es el veinte de junio.
teaching.explanationEs: Deadline + for: a qué corresponde el plazo.
teaching.audioText: The deadline for the deposit is the twentieth of June.

teaching.en: By the day we leave, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year.
teaching.es: Para el día de la salida, papá llevará un año ahorrando para este viaje.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have been saving + for: la duración proyectada hasta la salida.
segments: By the day we leave, Dad will have
been saving for this trip for a year.
teaching.audioText: By the day we leave, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year.

teaching.en: Would it be possible to confirm the dates today?
teaching.explanationEs: Would it be possible to + verbo: una petición cortés.
teaching.audioText: Would it be possible to confirm the dates today?

teaching.en: Then we all agree: we leave on the first of August.
teaching.es: Entonces todos estamos de acuerdo: salimos el uno de agosto.
teaching.explanationEs: Agree cierra el acuerdo con la información final.
segments: Then we all agree: we leave
teaching.audioText: Then we all agree: we leave on the first of August.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta: «Hay que pagar antes del lunes.»

feedback.es: By marca el plazo máximo para hacer algo; until y since no expresan un límite de entrega.

hint.es: Piensa en la fecha límite, no en cuánto dura algo.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Sería posible pagar el anticipo la semana que viene?»

feedback.es: Would it be possible to + verbo forma una petición cortés.

hint.es: Es la palabra que une possible con el verbo.

origin.text: Would it be possible ___ pay the deposit next week?

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase explica un plan que cambió?

choices.text: We were going to fly, but we will go by bus instead.
We will fly, but we were going by bus instead.
We are going to fly, but we were going to go by bus.

feedback.es: Was going to presenta el plan anterior y instead introduce lo que lo sustituye.

hint.es: El plan anterior va en pasado y la decisión nueva en futuro.

answer.text: Could you book the tickets for me today

feedback.es: Could you + verbo base forma una petición cortés; for me today la concreta.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿cuánto tiempo llevará ahorrando el padre en junio?

feedback.es: For a year equivale a doce meses: el tiempo que llevará ahorrando hasta finales de junio.

origin.audio: By the end of June, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year, so we can finally book the flights.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases del viaje.

answer.text: were going to go | will have booked | will have been saving
accepted: were going to go | will have booked | will have been saving

feedback.es: Were going to go es el plan que no se cumplió; by Friday pide un resultado; for a year, una duración (will have been saving; will have saved también se admite).

sentences: We ___ (go) to the coast, but it rained, so we stayed home.
By August, Dad ___ (save) for a year.

prompt.es: ¿Qué deben hacer los familiares antes del jueves?

feedback.es: El mensaje pide confirmar los asientos antes del jueves; el anticipo tiene otra fecha y el coche ya no es el plan.

origin.text: Hi all. We were going to rent a car, but the price went up, so we will take the train instead. Please confirm your seats by Thursday. The deadline for the deposit is 15 June.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hará el padre el sábado.

feedback.es: El padre se ofreció a ir al hotel el sábado; llamar era lo que iba a hacer quien habla, y la web no funcionaba.

origin.audio: I was going to book the hotel today, but the website was down. I was about to call them when your dad offered to go there on Saturday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Al terminar las vacaciones habremos estado en tres ciudades distintas.»

feedback.es: By the end of pide un resultado hasta un punto futuro: will have stayed (o will have been, «habremos estado»); will have been staying sugeriría una duración, no un recuento de ciudades.

origin.text: By the end of the holiday, we ___ in three different cities.

prompt.es: Escribe a tu familia en unas 50 palabras: plan cambiado, plazos, duración y acuerdo.

answer.text: We were going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house instead. We need to book it by Friday, and we must pay the deposit by the twentieth of June. By August, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year. Would it be possible to confirm the dates today? Then we all agree.
accepted: We were going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house instead. We need to book it by Friday, and we must pay the deposit by the twentieth of June. By August, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year. Would it be possible to confirm the dates today? Then we all agree.

We were going to book a hotel, but we will rent a house instead. We must book it by Friday, and we have to pay the deposit by June 20. By August, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year. Could we confirm the dates today? Then we all agree.

I was going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house. Could you book it by Friday? The deadline for the deposit is the twentieth of June. Dad will have been saving for a year by August. Would it be possible to confirm the dates today? Then we all agree.

feedback.es: El mensaje une el plan anterior (were going to), el plazo (by Friday), la duración (will have been saving), una petición cortés y el acuerdo final.

origin.text: Escribe unas 50 palabras (mínimo 40) a tu familia: íbamos a alojarnos en un hotel, pero alquilaremos una casa; hay que reservarla antes del viernes y pagar el anticipo antes del veinte de junio; para agosto, papá llevará un año ahorrando para este viaje; pide con cortesía confirmar las fechas hoy y cierra el acuerdo.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por favor, reserva las entradas antes del final de la semana.»

answer.text: Please book the tickets by the end of the week

feedback.es: Please + verbo forma una petición cortés y by the end of the week fija el plazo.

choices.text: Would it be possible to change the date?

feedback.es: Would it be possible to + verbo suaviza la petición; las otras dos suenan a orden.

prompt.es: Propón cortésmente confirmar las fechas hoy.

answer.text: Could we confirm the dates today?
accepted: Could we confirm the dates today?
Would it be possible to confirm the dates today?
Could you confirm the dates today?

feedback.es: Could we + verbo base o Would it be possible to + verbo forman una propuesta cortés.

origin.text: Quieres proponer de forma cortés que confirmen las fechas hoy.
